summary:
Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth, non-consecutive term in Sunday's runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. His win ended a string of conservative victories in Latin America. Official results gave Lula 51.7% of the vote, while the Superior Electoral Court put his share of valid votes at 51.8%. Bolsonaro has refused to concede, saying he will not give up and calling for the election to be annulled.

Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat in Sunday's snap parliamentary election, ending a 12-year reign after nearly two years of student-led protests against perceived corruption and authoritarianism. Turnout at polling stations was near 70%. Vučić said, 'It is clear that we have lost these elections.' Celebrations erupted across several Serbian cities late on Sunday.

Houthi forces have carried out waves of strikes on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, including an attack earlier this month that killed 13 people and injured more than 300. On Monday the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile and struck several Houthi missile launchers and storage facilities, while the Iran-backed Houthis claimed a new attack on the airport.

headlines.title: Lula wins fourth term as Bolsonaro refuses to concede
headlines.summary: Lula won a fourth, non-consecutive term over Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday's runoff, with 51.7% of the vote by official count or 51.8% of valid votes per the Superior Electoral Court. Bolsonaro has refused to concede and called for the election to be annulled.

headlines.title: Vučić concedes defeat in Serbian snap parliamentary election
headlines.summary: Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat in Sunday's snap parliamentary election, ending his 12-year rule after nearly two years of student-led protests. Turnout at polling stations was near 70%, and celebrations erupted in Belgrade and other Serbian cities.

headlines.title: María Corina Machado returns to Venezuela after nearly 10 months in exile
headlines.summary: Machado, a Nobel laureate, returned to Caracas on Sunday night after nearly ten months in exile and is pressing for new elections. Reports put the crowds at thousands and at tens of thousands.

headlines.title: Houthis strike Riyadh airport as Saudi coalition hits missile sites
headlines.summary: Houthi strikes on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh included an attack this month that killed 13 people and injured more than 300. On Monday the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile and struck Houthi missile launchers and storage facilities.

headlines.title: Israel votes Tuesday with West Bank crossings closed
headlines.summary: Israelis vote on Tuesday in an election that will determine the next prime minister, and the military has closed all land crossings between Israel and the West Bank on election day. The closure follows a deadly attack on Friday that killed two Israeli soldiers.

headlines.title: Nearly 2,000 Palestinians displaced from Hebron by Israeli forces
headlines.summary: Israeli forces have taken over homes in Hebron, the West Bank's largest city, and nearly 2,000 Palestinians have been displaced. The operation came days before Israel's election, after two Israeli soldiers were killed.

headlines.title: Communist Party opens fifth plenum focused on discipline
headlines.summary: China's Communist Party opened its fifth plenum in Beijing on Monday, a four-day closed meeting focused on party discipline and fighting corruption. Official media say adherence to the leadership of President Xi Jinping is key to the country's success.

headlines.title: Algeria approves sending troops to Niger, first foreign deployment since 1973
headlines.summary: Algeria's parliament on Sunday approved a resolution to send troops to Niger, the first deployment of Algerian soldiers abroad since the 1973 Arab-Israeli war. Niger faces persistent attacks by armed groups, including near its border with Algeria.
